about_the_game:
GrowBud - your bud-growing buddy that keeps you company while you work. Grow and master authentic cannabis strains, progress through grow clubs to unlock equipment advancements and customise your cultivation experience with multiple layers of short to long-term depth and progression.

What's Included in This Demo

6 Experimental Strain Variants
Cultivate 6 one-of-a-kind experimental variants based on real-world cannabis strains. These perennial plants cycle infinitely from vegetative growth through flowering, harvest, and back to vegetative. Harvest quality buds to earn gold and work toward leveling each strain to golden status - perfect for continuous idle cultivation while you work.

Club Introduction (Level 1 Only)
Get started with both The Grow Club (knowledge & craft) and The Bud Club (efficiency & yield). Complete level 1 challenges and unlock club rewards - this demo covers the first level of each club's progression.

Core Gene Expressions
Experiment with 5 strategic genetic modifiers to alter strain characteristics and enhance growth. Configure your grow environment and let your plants develop while you focus on other tasks - check back periodically to advance growth stages.

Active Growing Minigames
Master essential cultivation skills through hands-on trimming, pruning, and harvesting minigames that provide bonus rewards and keep you engaged during key growth transitions. Strategic pruning of bud sites keeps plants manageable and maximises quality bud production for better gold earnings.

Strain CollectionHibernate and revive strains between available grow houses, with hibernated plants displayed as a collection of jars in your strain library. Build your collection as you experiment with different variants and progression paths.

Full Desktop Companion Experience
Complete desktop companion functionality included: sits alongside your work, multi-monitor support, always-on-top toggle, and left/right anchoring. Grow while you work with seamless integration into your daily routine.

Demo vs. Full Game

This demo includes:

  • 6 strains (vs. 50+ in full game)

  • Level 1 of both clubs (vs. full progression system)

  • 5 attainable gene expressions (vs. complete expression library)

  • Core minigames (vs. expanded minigame variety)

  • Strain hibernation and library collection features

  • Complete grow cycles with infinite replay potential

Full game includes: Grow house customisation, equipment upgrades, consumables, all gene expressions, achievements, additional challenges, and many more strains.

Save Progress: We're working to ensure your demo progress can transfer to the full game - stay tuned for updates!

-----

Mature Content

Simulates cannabis cultivation for educational purposes. Designed for adult audiences.

content_descriptors.notes:
GrowBud is a cannabis cultivation simulation designed for adult audiences. Players grow virtual cannabis plants while learning about authentic strain gaenetics, growing techniques, and plant biology. The game presents cannabis cultivation from an educational and horticultural perspective.

The game includes:
- Simulation of cannabis plant cultivation from seed to harvest
- Educational information about real cannabis strain characteristics
- References to therapeutic applications of CBD strains within gameplay challenges
- Economic simulation involving the sale of harvested virtual crops

No explicit drug use is depicted or encouraged. The game focuses on the agricultural and scientific aspects of plant cultivation rather than consumption. All content is presented within an educational simulation framework appropriate for adult audiences interested in horticulture and plant biology.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics with 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / Apple M1 Pro or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics with 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
